Control Description: A cybersecurity strategy is defined, documented and approved by the head of the entity.
A roadmap implements the strategy, with initiatives reviewed at planned intervals.
A cybersecurity function independent from IT is established and staffed.
A steering committee oversees cybersecurity programmes and risks.
Cybersecurity policies and procedures are documented, approved and communicated.
Policies are reviewed at planned intervals or after significant change.
An inventory of information and technology assets is maintained.
Assets are classified and labelled according to their sensitivity.
Multi-factor authentication is enforced for remote and privileged access.
User access rights are reviewed periodically and on role change.
Privileged accounts are managed through a dedicated access solution.
Systems are scanned for vulnerabilities and findings are remediated by risk.
Scanning covers internet-facing systems at least monthly.
Cybersecurity requirements are part of business continuity management.
Continuity and recovery plans are tested at planned intervals.
